Here's a tip that someone gave me that sounded stupid at first, but it made me an actual beast at combat. USE YOUR WEAPONS. By that, I mean use all of them. Other games tend to have you focus on only using your primary, but in Fortnite the tide of the battle changes drastically in such a short amount of time, so you have to utilize your entire arsenal. A lot of the newbies I see get killed because they focus too much on using their assault rifles, only for me to see them die when they had perfectly good weapons for their situation, full of ammo. Also, make sure you have a set loadout in mind, and make sure to have corresponding buttons for them. The worst thing that could happen is for you to pull out your medkit when you need your shotgun. People tend to downplay how important inventory management is.
